title: GSRTC Tracker
meta_description: Show the live location of GSRTC (ST) Bus.
full_description: GSRTC Tracker provide convenient way to get  live location of GSRTC (ST) Bus. Track your bus using bus number or Source-Destination. User can set the targeted location whenever bus reaches at the  targeted location user get notification. Shows in notification progress bar for live tracking also provide some additional information like distance(km), estimated arrival time.
